verdict.rationale: Serving embedding models is a fair question for an on-device and hosted inference SDK, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only LLM generation, chat, structured output, tool calling, STT, TTS, VAD, diarization, VLM and image generation. Nothing mentions an embeddings API or embedding models for retrieval or search. The OpenAI-compatible hosted endpoint is documented only for chat completions and does not show embedding support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve embedding models for retrieval and search applications
